ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV pre-encryption tamper chain: safeboot reboot + VSS wipe + event-log clear
ucs.description: Hunts the characteristic BlackCat (ALPHV/Noberus) pre-detonation sequence where the encryptor (or operator) reboots into Safe Mode with Networking via bcdedit, deletes Volume Shadow Copies via vssadmin/wmic, and clears Windows event logs via wevtutil — all within a short window on the same host. This bcdedit-safeboot-network trick is a signature BlackCat behaviour (CrowdStrike: SLIPPY SPIDER, Microsoft: tracked under DEV-0237/DEV-0504 affiliates) and is rarely seen in benign workflows.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as procs from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe Processes.process="*safeboot*") OR (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name=wevtutil.exe Processes.process="*cl *") OR (Processes.process_name=iisreset.exe Processes.process="*/stop*") by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=30m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval tamper_type=case(match(process,"(?i)safeboot"),"safeboot_reboot", match(process,"(?i)shadow"),"vss_wipe", match(process,"(?i)wevtutil"),"log_clear", match(process,"(?i)iisreset"),"svc_stop", 1=1,"other") | stats dc(tamper_type) as distinct_actions values(tamper_type) as actions values(process) as cmds values(process_name) as binaries min(first_seen) as first_seen max(last_seen) as last_seen by dest user | where distinct_actions >= 2 | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot")
     or (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bcl\b")
     or (FileName =~ "iisreset.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/stop")
| extend TamperType = case(
    ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot", "safeboot_reboot",
    ProcessCommandLine has "shadow", "vss_wipe",
    FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe", "log_clear",
    FileName =~ "iisreset.exe", "svc_stop",
    "other")
| summarize DistinctActions = dcount(TamperType),
            Actions = make_set(TamperType),
            Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 16),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 30m)
| where DistinctActions >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:

| where EventID == 4688

     or (Bin == "wmic.exe" and Cmd has "shadowcopy" and Cmd has "delete")
     or (Bin == "wevtutil.exe" and Cmd matches regex @"\bcl\b")
     or (Bin == "iisreset.exe" and Cmd has "/stop")
| extend TamperType = case(
    Cmd has "safeboot", "safeboot_reboot",
    Cmd has "shadow", "vss_wipe",
    Bin == "wevtutil.exe", "log_clear",
    Bin == "iisreset.exe", "svc_stop",
    "other")
| summarize DistinctActions = dcount(TamperType),
            Actions = make_set(TamperType),
            Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 16),
            Binaries = make_set(Bin),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where DistinctActions >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc

| (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/safeboot/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wevtutil\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/\bcl\b/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\iisreset\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/\/stop/i)
| TamperType := if(CommandLine=/safeboot/i, "safeboot_reboot",

| DistinctActions >= 2
| sort(LastSeen, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV Rust encryptor execution via `--access-token` and propagation flags
ucs.description: Hunts execution of the BlackCat/ALPHV/Noberus Rust-based encryptor by its required `--access-token <hex>` affiliate gate flag plus its idiosyncratic propagation/VM-kill switches (`--no-prop`, `--no-vm-kill`, `--child-thread`, `--propagated`, `--prop-file`). These flags are hard-coded into the affiliate binary and have no overlap with legitimate Windows tooling — they are the cleanest in-line indicator for this RaaS family.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.process_path) as paths values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process IN ("*--access-token*", "*--no-prop*", "*--no-vm-kill*", "*--child-thread*", "*--propagated*", "*--prop-file*", "*--propagated-token*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval flag_hits = mvcount(mvfilter(match(process, "(?i)--(access-token|no-prop|no-vm-kill|child-thread|propagated|prop-file)"))) | where flag_hits >= 1 AND NOT match(process_name, "(?i)^(nuget|msiexec|az|aws|gh|gcloud|kubectl)\.exe$") | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--access-token", "--no-prop", "--no-vm-kill", "--child-thread", "--propagated", "--prop-file", "--propagated-token")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("nuget.exe","msiexec.exe","az.exe","aws.exe","gh.exe","gcloud.exe","kubectl.exe","docker.exe")
| where FileName !in~ ("nuget.exe","msiexec.exe","az.exe","aws.exe","gh.exe","gcloud.exe","kubectl.exe","docker.exe")
| extend AccessTokenHex = extract(@"(?i)--access-token\s+([A-Fa-f0-9]{32,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Flags = extract_all(@"(?i)--(access-token|no-prop|no-vm-kill|child-thread|propagated|prop-file|propagated-token)", ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          AccessTokenHex, Flags, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:

| extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where Bin !in ("nuget.exe","msiexec.exe","az.exe","aws.exe","gh.exe","gcloud.exe","kubectl.exe","docker.exe")
| extend AccessTokenHex = extract(@"(?i)--access-token\s+([A-Fa-f0-9]{32,})", 1, CommandLine)

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackCat/ALPHV Ransomware Encryptor Affiliate CLI Flags
id: 7c4a9b2e-1e9f-4a3c-9a2b-blackcat-cli-flags
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of the BlackCat/ALPHV/Noberus Rust encryptor identified by its mandatory --access-token affiliate gate flag and characteristic propagation/VM-kill switches.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/06/13/the-many-lives-of-blackcat-ransomware/
  - https://symantec-enterprise-blogs.security.com/blogs/threat-intelligence/noberus-blackcat-alphv
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-061a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1059
  - detection.alphv
  - detection.blackcat
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_token:
    CommandLine|contains: '--access-token'
  selection_propflags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '--no-prop'
      - '--no-vm-kill'
      - '--child-thread'
      - '--propagated'
      - '--prop-file'
      - '--propagated-token'
  filter_legit:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\nuget.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\az.exe'
      - '\aws.exe'
      - '\gh.exe'
      - '\gcloud.exe'
      - '\kubectl.exe'
      - '\docker.exe'
  condition: (selection_token or selection_propflags) and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Rare custom internal tooling that mimics these flag names
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @CommandLine:(*--access-token* OR *--no-prop* OR *--no-vm-kill* OR *--child-thread* OR *--propagated* OR *--prop-file* OR *--propagated-token*) -@Image:(*\\nuget.exe OR *\\NuGet.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\az.exe OR *\\aws.exe OR *\\gh.exe OR *\\gcloud.exe OR *\\kubectl.exe OR *\\docker.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| CommandLine=/--(access-token|no-prop|no-vm-kill|child-thread|propagated|prop-file|propagated-token)\b/i
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(nuget|msiexec|az|aws|gh|gcloud|kubectl|docker)\.exe$/i
| AccessTokenHex := regex("(?i)--access-token\\s+(?<hex>[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,})", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, SHA256HashData], function=[count(), collect([CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, AccessTokenHex]), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| sort(LastSeen, order=desc)
